dateline: BTS closed three sold-out La Plata nights (Oct 21, 23, 24) of the ARIRANG World Tour; São Paulo shows at Estádio MorumBIS were scheduled for Oct 28, 30 and 31, with no post-show reports verified yet.
heroHeadline: Day 4,888: BTS in São Paulo for ARIRANG World Tour
heroSubtitle: October 31, 2026 is Day 4,888 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. After three La Plata nights, the ARIRANG World Tour is in its three-date São Paulo leg (Oct 28, 30, 31) at Estádio MorumBIS; the Oct 30 show was slated for cinema live viewing.
